Settings

Spectrogram

The frequency ceiling cannot exceed half the analysis sample rate.

Resampling filters apply when the analysis sample rate differs from the input.

Appearance

Pre-emphasis boosts higher frequencies for display. Quiet-frame boost makes weaker moments more visible. Both change displayed brightness, not the recorded sound. Relative colour levels retain a decaying peak; dynamic range applies to automatic and fixed levels.

Formants

Tracks are estimates; gaps indicate missing or rejected measurements.

Developer settings

Performance diagnostics

Enable before starting a test. Run for several minutes, then export the report. No audio is included or uploaded. Reset after changing settings.

Speech test input

38 seconds of Alice Waters speaking in an English-language interview. Feeds the same Praat processing pipeline as the microphone; no mic permission needed.
